usage.name: Personal Chest
usage.use_when: Opens personal storage from anywhere (player UI).

usage.name: Rocksplosion
usage.use_when: Breaks apart nearby boulders and ore; use while mining.

usage.name: Confuse
usage.use_when: Lesser enemies can't tell friend from foe for a while; use when outnumbered by weak enemies.

usage.name: Fishnado
usage.use_when: A tornado pulls up to 5 fish out of the water.

usage.name: Infernal Rod
usage.use_when: Fish caught are cooked for 2 minutes.

usage.name: Fire Spirit
usage.use_when: Summons a fire spirit that gives light.

usage.name: Uproot
preconditions: ripe crops or wild plants within a few metres
usage.use_when: Instantly harvests ripe and wild plants in a small radius.

usage.name: Enchant Weapon: Water
usage.use_when: Adds Water damage and occasional healing orbs; good for sustained melee when not fighting Kalphites.

usage.name: Tempest Shield
preconditions: in combat or a fight is about to start
incoming big telegraph, or own HP below ~50%
usage.use_when: Block all damage for about a minute; cast before a big hit lands or when HP is low. Save it for bosses if Luis asks.

usage.name: Magical Mending
preconditions: damaged item(s) dropped on the ground near the caster
usage.use_when: Repairs damaged gear that Luis drops on the floor next to the bot.
usage.mechanism: SpellModule_UtilityMagic spawns an AUtilitySpell actor; URepairSpellComponent:RepairEquipmentOfNearbyPlayers() (no args) with SpellConfig{SpellRange, DurabilityTierPercentageMap, UsedItemsCollection}, bIncludeInventory/bIncludeLoadout/bIgnoreItemRequirements. Wiki: repairs dropped items instantly. Items carry UItem.Durability.

usage.name: Shadow Veil
usage.use_when: Cast Shadow Veil (no usage notes yet).

usage.name: Enchant Weapon: Earth
preconditions: target not Earth-resistant (Kalphites do not resist Earth)
usage.use_when: Adds Earth damage to melee hits; a good enchant against Kalphites.

usage.name: Enchant Weapon: Fire
preconditions: target weak to Fire or not Fire-resistant (goblins)
usage.use_when: Adds Fire to melee hits (burn on crit); use against Fire-weak enemies such as goblins.

usage.name: Magic Focus
usage.use_when: Cast Magic Focus (no usage notes yet).

usage.name: Snare
preconditions: enemies approaching along a predictable path
usage.use_when: A trap that roots enemies that walk into it; place it between enemies and Luis.

usage.name: Spectral Arrows
usage.use_when: Arrows pierce several targets and bypass Ranged resistance for 5 minutes; use with a bow vs Ranged-resistant enemies.

usage.name: Windstep
preconditions: enemy cluster >= 3 within ~5 m of the landing point (Kalphites especially)
no player within 10 m of the landing point
usage.use_when: Wind Stomp: an AoE stagger at the landing point; use on groups (great vs Kalphites), then hit them while they stumble.

usage.name: Trunk Totem
usage.use_when: Gathers scattered felled trunks into one totem; then cast Splinter on it to get all the logs.

usage.name: Enchant Chef's Tools
usage.use_when: Cast Enchant Chef's Tools (no usage notes yet).

usage.name: Rapid Growth
usage.use_when: Advances plant growth by one stage.

usage.name: Runes To Rune Essence
preconditions: unwanted runes dropped on the ground
usage.use_when: Converts dropped runes back into 40% of their essence.

usage.name: Cabbage Rain
usage.use_when: Cast Cabbage Rain (no usage notes yet).

usage.use_when: Advances plant growth.

usage.name: Phase Dash

usage.name: Eye Of Oculus
usage.use_when: A building camera view; player-only.

usage.use_when: Alternative radar for minable rocks.

usage.name: Vengeance
